text: Mi deh pon hold long time now, so me a try di text. Mi a childminder, lickle bwoy 11 months, temperature 38. Him eczema a flare up bad, dry patches pon him arm dem an back of him knee, an him a scratch scratch all evening. Him still a drink him milk an eat him food normal, no problem deh. Mi jus waan know if mi can put di cream pon it an give him something fi di temperature before him mother come, cause nobody nah answer di phone
